topic: Why You Lose Focus After 3 Days
caption:
Motivation temporary hai, system permanent hai.
Har Monday naya josh aata hai aur Wednesday tak gayab?
Problem tumhari intentions mein nahi, tumhare oversized goals mein hai.
Slide check karo aur aaj se lower-friction system start karo.

Aaj kaunsi 1 habit par kaam karoge? Comments mein batao!

Follow karo @ctrl_thoughts_ for daily motivation ideas.
